title: Sum of Cubes Identity
formula: a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² - ab - bc - ca)
alternate: = ½ (a + b + c)[(a - b)² + (b - c)² + (c - a)²]
key_note: If a + b + c = 0 or a = b = c, then a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc

title: Third Form: (a + b + c) & Sum of Products
formula: a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = (a + b + c)[(a + b + c)² - 3(ab + bc + ca)]
key_note: Extremely frequent in SSC Tier 1 & 2 when (a+b+c) and (ab+bc+ca) are given.

title: Reciprocal Power Shortcuts
formula:
If x + 1/x = k, then:
• x² + 1/x² = k² - 2
• x³ + 1/x³ = k³ - 3k
• x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = (k² - 2)² - 2
• x⁵ + 1/x⁵ = (x² + 1/x²)(x³ + 1/x³) - (x + 1/x)
key_note: If x - 1/x = k: x² + 1/x² = k² + 2, x³ - 1/x³ = k³ + 3k

title: Square of Trinomial
formula: (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)
key_note: ab + bc + ca = ½ [(a + b + c)² - (a² + b² + c²)]

title: Inradius & Circumradius (General Triangle)
formula:
Inradius (r) = Δ / s
Circumradius (R) = (a × b × c) / (4Δ)
key_note: where Δ = Area of triangle, s = semi-perimeter = (a+b+c)/2

title: Inradius & Circumradius (Right-Angled Triangle)
key_note: In a right triangle, circumcentre is the midpoint of the hypotenuse.

title: Inradius & Circumradius (Equilateral Triangle)
formula:
r = a / (2√3)
R = a / √3
Ratio R : r = 2 : 1
key_note: Area of incircle : Area of circumcircle = 1 : 4

title: Direct & Transverse Common Tangents
formula:
DCT = √(d² - (r₁ - r₂)²)
TCT = √(d² - (r₁ + r₂)²)
key_note: d = distance between centres; r₁, r₂ = radii (DCT is always longer than TCT)

title: Apollonius' Theorem (Median Relation)
formula: AB² + AC² = 2(AD² + BD²)
key_note: Where AD is the median on side BC (and BD = CD = BC/2)

title: Cone & Frustum of Cone
formula:
Cone Vol = ⅓ π r² h,  CSA = π r l  (l = √(r² + h²))
Frustum Vol = ⅓ π h (R² + r² + Rr)
Frustum CSA = π l (R + r), where l = √(h² + (R - r)²)
key_note: TSA = CSA + π(R² + r²)

title: Hemisphere & Sphere
formula:
Sphere: Vol = ⁴⁄₃ π r³,  Surface Area = 4 π r²
Hemisphere: Vol = ⅔ π r³,  CSA = 2 π r²,  TSA = 3 π r²
key_note: Hollow hemisphere TSA = 2π(R² + r²) + π(R² - r²) = 3πR² + πr²

title: Prism & Pyramid
formula:
Prism: Vol = Base Area × Height,  LSA = Base Perimeter × Height
Pyramid: Vol = ⅓ × Base Area × Height,  LSA = ½ × Base Perimeter × Slant Height (l)
key_note: TSA = LSA + Base Area (for pyramid) / 2×Base Area (for prism)

title: Important Special Angles (15° & 75°)
key_note: tan 15° × tan 75° = 1

title: Maxima & Minima of Trigonometric Functions
formula:
For a sin θ + b cos θ:  Max = +√(a² + b²),  Min = -√(a² + b²)
For a sin²θ + b cos²θ:  Max = max(a, b),  Min = min(a, b)
For a tan²θ + b cot²θ:  Min = 2√(ab) (Max is ∞)
For a sin²θ + b cosec²θ: Min = 2√(ab)
key_note: Very standard question in SSC CGL Tier 1/2

title: Secant & Cosecant Identities Shortcuts
formula:
If sec θ + tan θ = x  ⟹  sec θ - tan θ = 1/x  ⟹  sec θ = ½(x + 1/x),  tan θ = ½(x - 1/x)
If cosec θ + cot θ = y  ⟹  cosec θ - cot θ = 1/y
key_note: Allows finding any trig ratio in < 5 seconds.

title: Difference between CI and SI
formula:
For 2 Years: Diff = P × (R / 100)²
For 3 Years: Diff = P × (R / 100)² × [(300 + R) / 100]
key_note: R is annual interest rate %, P is Principal

title: Successive Percentage Change
formula:
Net % Change = a + b + (a × b) / 100
For 2 successive discounts d₁ & d₂: Equivalent Discount = (d₁ + d₂ - (d₁ × d₂) / 100) %
key_note: Use positive sign for increase/profit and negative for decrease/loss/discount.

title: Time, Speed & Distance: Meeting Point Formula
formula:
If two trains start towards each other and after meeting take T₁ and T₂ to reach their destinations:
Speed₁ / Speed₂ = √(T₂ / T₁)
key_note: Also, time to meet = √(T₁ × T₂)

title: Average Speed Formulas
formula:
Equal distance (2 parts): Avg Speed = 2xy / (x + y)
Equal distance (3 parts): Avg Speed = 3xyz / (xy + yz + zx)
General: Avg Speed = Total Distance / Total Time
key_note: x, y, z are speeds across equal distance intervals

title: Quadratic Equation Sign Rule (Banking PO / Clerk)
formula:
Equation: ax² + bx + c = 0
• Signs (+, +) ⟹ Roots: (-, -)
• Signs (-, +) ⟹ Roots: (+, +)
• Signs (+, -) ⟹ Roots: (-, +)
• Signs (-, -) ⟹ Roots: (+, -)
key_note: If both constant terms are negative (c < 0 in both equations), relationship is always 'Cannot be Determined (CND)'!
